name: Tower of the Damned
source:
"Have you ever heard of urban legends before? Yeah, they're those stupid stories that no one really believes in. There was an urban legend in my town once. A really weird one, actually. It was about a group of 4 kids that would go missing every 5 years. They would just... disappear. No sight of them alive. or dead. It's like they never even existed. Sounds like bullshit, right? I didn't believe it either... 

Until now.

[From [url=https://mlekkel.itch.io/tower-of-the-damned]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“你以前听说过都市传说吗？是的，那些愚蠢的故事没有人真正相信。我的镇上曾经有一个都市传说。实际上是一个非常奇怪的故事。它是关于一群4个孩子每5年就会失踪一次。他们会……消失。看不到他们活着或死了。就像他们根本不存在一样。听起来像废话，对吧？我也不相信…… 

直到现在。”

[来自[url=https://mlekkel.itch.io/tower-of-the-damned]Itch.io[/url]]
